parameters.query:
-- appointments.location_id is a foreign key; the location row is ensured
-- once here so the nightly sync below can insert human-booked appointments
-- it has never seen before.
INSERT INTO locations (location_id, business_name, timezone, calendar_id)
VALUES ($1, 'Bright Smile Dental', 'America/New_York', '')
ON CONFLICT (location_id) DO NOTHING;

-- The calendar API does not know who booked what. The database does, for
-- agent bookings (call_id is set). Everything else in the window is treated
-- as human-booked -- that is the whole point of the comparison, and the
-- reason 'booked_by' is a column and not a guess.
SELECT appointment_id
FROM appointments
WHERE booked_by = 'agent';

-- Idempotent on appointment_id: the same window is re-fetched nightly.
-- The insert covers human-booked appointments the store has never seen;
-- the conflict arm only ever refreshes status fields, never booked_by.
INSERT INTO appointments
  (appointment_id, location_id, contact_id, booked_by, booked_at,
   starts_at, status, status_at, synced_at)
SELECT r->>'appointment_id',
       $2,
       NULL,
       r->>'booked_by',
       NULLIF(r->>'booked_at', '')::timestamptz,
       (r->>'starts_at')::timestamptz,
       r->>'status',
       NULLIF(r->>'status_at', '')::timestamptz,
       now()
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS r
ON CONFLICT (appointment_id) DO UPDATE
   SET status    = EXCLUDED.status,
       status_at = EXCLUDED.status_at,
       synced_at = now();

-- Yesterday, through the console's own lens: what the agent handled,
-- what it cost, and what a human had to take. Empty is a signal, not a
-- zero -- a day with no calls is either a broken integration or a quiet
-- day, and this line exists so somebody notices which.
SELECT day, calls, booked, escalated, messages, abandoned,
       book_rate_pct, containment_pct, avg_secs, cost_usd, cost_per_booking_usd
FROM v_call_outcomes
WHERE location_id = $1
  AND day = (current_date - 1)
ORDER BY day;

-- The comparison this whole system exists to make honest. Only past
-- appointments count, and the split is published even when it flatters a
-- human -- burying an unflattering number makes every other one suspect.
SELECT booked_by, appointments, attended, no_shows, cancelled, show_rate_pct
FROM v_show_rate_by_booker
WHERE location_id = $1
ORDER BY booked_by;
